runtime_catalog.note: before_gate is the measured pre-gate catalog. listing_tokens_full_estimate is the summed on-invoke cost of every local and plugin skill, used as the pre-gate listing cost proxy; the exact pre-gate listing was not tokenised at the time.

repair.note: The taxonomy's keyword lists were repaired after an error analysis on the dev half of the benchmark. The test half was not consulted. evals/taxonomy-v1.json holds the pre-repair set and evals/taxonomy-ablation.md holds the ablation.

parking.note: The 1,076 directories under ~/.agents/skills are invisible to mcode (external roots gated off) and are the router's local library.
